product.title: Historical Railroad Trail eBike Tour

description.text: The Historic Railroad Trail is a beautiful route next to Lake Mead, which finishes at the Hoover Dam. Instead of hiking, explore this beautiful scenery with less effort by going on a guided e-bike tour. All the equipment you need is provided, including an electric bike, eye protection, and a helmet.

highlights: Cycle along the Historic Railroad Trail toward Hoover Dam with a guide.
Includes e-bike, helmet, eye protection, snacks, and bottled water.
Multiple departure times and optional hotel pickup for eligible groups.
Small-group format capped at four travelers.
inclusions: Hotel pick-up and drop off (for groups of 2+ only)
additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
Travelers should have a moderate physical fitness level
eBikes have full throttle and pedal assist
Guests must be 16 years or older to participate
Please, no flip flops or sandals

meetingPoint.name: Lakeshore Drive
meetingPoint.description: Lakeshore Dr, Nevada 89005, USA. For groups of 1, please reach out prior to booking to confirm availability. Meet 15 minutes prior to start time in the Lake Mead Visitor parking lot.

itineraryItems.title: Hemenway Park
itineraryItems.description: Start with a brief stop and orientation near Boulder City.

itineraryItems.title: Lake Mead Visitor Center
itineraryItems.description: Ride through the Lake Mead area before continuing to the rail corridor.

itineraryItems.title: Historic Railroad Trail
itineraryItems.description: Follow the rail corridor route toward Hoover Dam with tunnels and lake views.

itineraryItems.title: Hoover Dam
itineraryItems.description: Arrive at Hoover Dam with time for guided context and photos.
